title: Slovakia Faces Twin Pressures of Stalling Growth and Mounting Debt · 21 Aug
keywords: Slovakia, GDP growth, public debt, fiscal policy, eurozone, EU deficit rules, Central Europe, industrial competitiveness, Budgetary Responsibility Council, inflation, economic outlook
notes: Slovakia's economy expanded by just 0.7 percent year-on-year in the second quarter of 2026, its weakest performance in four quarters, while public debt is projected to approach 75 percent of GDP by the end of the decade. The combination of fragile growth and narrowing fiscal space is leaving households with little tangible relief despite government assurances of stability. Brussels is expected to watch Bratislava's deficit and reform commitments more closely as a result.
